one_line_description: Platform for frontend frameworks and static sites
auth_methods_evidence: Vercel Access Tokens are required to authenticate and use the Vercel API. Include the token in the `Authorization` header: `Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>`
self_serve_evidence: Create and manage Access Tokens in your [account settings](https://vercel.com/account/tokens).
buildability_rationale: Self-serve access with good documentation, broad API surface, and API key authentication.
agent_notes: The API is well-documented with clear authentication instructions and a broad range of endpoints.
